text:
Maria L.: Quick scrub — Q2 hosted GPU commitment bids. I pulled last week's bidboard and APAC lead times look worse than forecast. Can we do a quick sync? (cc @Alex R.)
Alex R.: On it. Do we have updated GPU-hour forecast? I saw a spike from a couple finetune customers.
Maria L.: Updated projection in the sheet: https://redwood.app/sheets/hosted-q2-forecast. TL;DR: +28% peak GPU-hrs week 26 vs baseline.
Chao W.: 28%? that's higher than our surge model. what's the expected p95 seq len on those jobs?
Maria L.: p95 seq len ~1.2k tokens for text-gen routes; chat routes add tail.
Priya S.: APAC rack lead time now 10–12 weeks per vendor. US still ~6–8 weeks.
Sam T.: Cost quick calc (rough):
```
option_a_lease: 6mo, $0.75/gpu-hr
option_b_buy: capex $150k per chassis, amort 3y -> ~$0.30/gpu-hr at 50% util
expected_peak_util = 0.7
```
Sam T.: If we assume 70% util, buy cheaper long-run but we need cash/runway and spare parts.
Alex R.: Suggest a blend: buy for steady US baseline, lease burst for APAC/edge. Maybe 60% buy / 40% lease.
Priya S.: Note: APAC networking + customs can add 2–3 weeks unpredictability. For edge racks prefer smaller, local vendors with faster ship.
Maria L.: Can infra run scenario sims for 3 demand curves (baseline / optimistic / surge) and include the OOM impact?
infra-bot: capacity-sim/2012345678 started by Maria L. — results ETA ~2h.
Chao W.: Also FYI cluster health: OOM rate up ~12% last week on g4x pools after kernel patch. Filed INF-3179: https://redwood.app/t/INF-3179
Maria L.: Good catch. If we lose ~5% effective capacity to OOMs, that pushes required buy % up by ~8 chassis.
Sam T.: Action: I'll draft the procurement ask and a backstop plan. Need final numbers by Friday EOD.
Alex R.: I'll update the cost sheet and add burn-sensitivity slides for exec.
Priya S.: I'll chase APAC vendor lead times and confirm shipping windows + customs hold risk.
Maria L.: Thanks team. Quick poll — react with :one: for 4:2 (buy:lease) or :two: for 6:4.
Alex R.: :one: (4:2)
Chao W.: :two: (6:4) — prefer more headroom if OOMs persist
Sam T.: :one:
Priya S.: :one:
Maria L.: ok leaning 4:2. I'll open PR for purchase approval and tag finance.
infra-bot: ticket INF-3182 created to track procurement PR and approvals.
